register.name: PCI_IATU_REGION_CTRL_1_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Region Control 1 Register. This register controls the iATU outbound region access based on the optional iATU outbound features enabled using iATU Region Control 2 Register.

register.name: PCI_IATU_REGION_CTRL_2_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Region Control 2 Register. Using this register you can enable/disable the outbound iATU optional features.

register.name: PCI_IATU_LWR_BASE_ADDR_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Lower Base Address Register. The CX_ATU_MIN_REGION_SIZE configuration parameter (Value Range: 4 kB, 8 kB, 16 kB, 32 kB, 64 kB defaults to 64 kB) specifies the minimum size of an address translation region. For example, if set to 64 kB; the lower 16 bits of the Base, Limit and Target registers are zero and all address regions are aligned on 64 kB boundaries. More precisely, the lower log2(CX_ATU_MIN_REGION_SIZE) bits are zero.

register.name: PCI_IATU_UPPER_BASE_ADDR_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Upper Base Address Register. This register holds the upper 32-bits of the start (and end) address of the address region to be translated.

register.name: PCI_IATU_LIMIT_ADDR_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Limit Address Register. This register holds the end address of the address region to be translated.

register.name: PCI_IATU_LWR_TARGET_ADDR_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Lower Target Address Register. This register holds the Lower Target part of the new address of the translated region, or the outbound TLP header information, depending on the setting of HEADER_SUBSTITUTE_EN field of IATU_REGION_CTRL_2_VIEWPORT_OFF_OUTBOUND_i register.

register.name: PCI_IATU_UPPER_TARGET_ADDR_OFF_OUTBOUND_0
register.comment: iATU Upper Target Address Register. This register holds the upper 32 bits of the start address (Upper Target part) of the new address of the translated region.

register.comment: iATU Region Control 1 Register. This register controls the iATU outbound region access based on the optional iATU outbound features enabled using iATU Region Control 2 Register.
